changes: Enable single-case execution and propagate its exit status. Extend answered-request coverage through its deadline. Assert capture-checkpoint elapsed time and watcher termination.
cleanup: Final git status contains only the three intentional test-file edits; no transient test artifacts remain in the worktree.
diagnosis: The previous unrelated delivery-suite timeout was classified by the user as a slow-host artifact. It was not rerun. No product assertion failure reproduced in the authorized focused cases. Existing scripts lacked individual case selection, so the repository FM_TEST_ONLY convention was applied.
limitations: Remote routes use isolated local fixtures; no SSH or live agent-station session was exercised.
External timeout/gtimeout variant skipped because neither tool is installed; native Perl and separate-process-group cleanup passed.
Hosted CI owns broad spawn/promote and full-suite regression. No linters, formatters, static analysis, pipeline control, publication, or CI phases were run.
The capture checkpoint assertion allows five seconds execution, five seconds cleanup, and two seconds scheduling allowance; recorded script duration also includes fixture setup and teardown.

scenarios.name: Existing worker delivery contracts complete successfully
A lock-refused secondmate stays read-only and reports one blocker
Verified recovery closes the source episode and permits a new refusal
A lock-refused main home publishes no parent-channel report
Unanswered request and recovery waits escalate at their own one-hour deadline
Completed request and recovery turns retain completion grace
Stale remote mirrors withhold escalation and late replies close blockers
Bounded checkpoints clean up TERM-resistant watchers and separate capture groups

scope: Assigned Test phase only; individual executable fixtures against production interfaces, sequentially bounded at 60 seconds with five seconds termination grace.
